headline: Moroccan Dirham Depreciates 3.7% Against US Dollar in October
summary: The Moroccan dirham depreciated 3.7% against the US dollar and 1.2% against the euro between September and October 2026, according to monthly data released by Bank Al-Maghrib.
why: Moroccan dirham exchange rate adjustments impact import costs for North Africa's largest energy and grain importer.

impacts.name: Moroccan Dirham
impacts.why: Central bank tracking showed a 3.7% decline against the US currency over the monthly period.
